description: Portability classification for Skills present in the public CloudBox artifact.

tiers.portable: No dependency on scripts/*.py, cloudbox-skills-eval*, .local/, or other CloudSkill-repository-relative tooling. Safe to package as a standalone zip for claude.ai/Desktop/API upload as-is.
tiers.hybrid: Core judgment/methodology is portable, but some documented workflow steps invoke CloudSkill-repository scripts or assume repository-relative paths that will not function in a sandboxed surface. Package as-is but disclose the non-functional steps; do not silently strip them.
tiers.cli-only: Assumes filesystem/subprocess access to this repository's own scripts and local state throughout. Do not package for claude.ai/Desktop/API upload.
